fusions.name: Grasp of Force
fusions.desc: Throws out a hand of force that seizes the first enemy it meets, dealing 12 damage and stunning it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Troop Thunder
fusions.desc: Releases a burst of arcana that deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Long-Armed Haul
fusions.desc: Lays a line of force 5 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward.

fusions.name: Knuckles Alight
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, your physical damage rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
